_comment: USPS standard abbreviations (Publication 28) used to send a job's street line to a county parcel service the way assessor data usually stores it (backend/src/parcelJurisdiction.ts normalizeStreet, addressStyle 'usps'). Suffixes are abbreviated after the street name's first word; directionals as the first word after the house number or the last word. Data, so the table can grow without code.
